answer: Locks are entered in nebula, expire in wander, and relic lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 58 aliases hence needs 169 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1802 identities would post 3403 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
